task_summary: Ran the validated Seykota trend harness (net/gross/control) on in-repo gold (XAUUSD M15) and BTC (BTCUSD H1) data; both show negative GROSS expectancy (gold −0.174R, BTC −0.107R) so the trend core has no raw edge — NET≈GROSS (cost not the killer), EMA filter only marginally beats the plain-Donchian control; no equity-index data exists in-repo.
